title: Lead Generation for Small Businesses: Hong Kong edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Trust: put the business registration number, a real address and a refund note on every page.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
